local function v_u_109(p101) -- name: parse_duration
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_100
	if typeof(p101) ~= "string" then
		error("cannot parse non string")
	end
	local v102 = 0
	for _, v103 in string.split(p101, " ") do
		local v104, v105 = string.match(v103, "(.-)[%s]?([A-z]+)$")
		if v104 and v105 then
			local v106 = v_u_100[v105]
			if not v106 then
				error(("\"%*\" is not a valid suffix"):format(v106), 0)
			end
			local v107 = tonumber(v104)
			if not v107 then
				error(("could not convert \"%*\" into a duration"):format(v103), 0)
			end
			v102 = v102 + v107 * v106
		else
			local v108 = tonumber(v103)
			if not v108 then
				error(("could not convert \"%*\" into a duration"):format(v103), 0)
			end
			v102 = v102 + v108
		end
	end
	return v102
end

	for v63, v64 in p61.arguments do
		local v65 = v64.span
		if (p60.cursor < v65.x and "before" or (p60.cursor > v65.y and "after" or "within")) == "within" then
			return v63
		end
		local v66 = v64.span
		if (p60.cursor < v66.x and "before" or (p60.cursor > v66.y and "after" or "within")) ~= "after" then
			continue
		end
		v62 = v63 + 1
	end
	return v62
end
local function v_u_84(p68, p69, p70) -- name: match_eval_value
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_84
	if p69.kind == "literal" then
		if p68 == p69.value then
			return p69
		else
			return nil
		end
	elseif p69.kind == "command" or p69.kind == "function" then
		if typeof(p68) == "function" then
			return p69
		else
			return nil
		end
	elseif p69.kind == "strange" then
		local v71
		if p70 then
			v71 = p69.exact_match or p69.match
		else
			v71 = p69.match
		end
		if v71 then
			if typeof(v71) == "table" then
				if v_u_84(p68, v71, p70) then
					return p69
				else
					return nil
				end
			elseif v71(p68) then
				return p69
			else
				return nil
			end
		else
			return p69
		end
	else
		if p69.kind == "intersection" then
			for _, v72 in p69.fields do
				if v_u_84(p68, v72, p70) then
					continue
				end
				return nil
			end
			return p69
		end
		if p69.kind == "union" then
			local v73 = {}
			for _, v74 in p69.fields do
				if not v_u_84(p68, v74, p70) then
					continue
				end
				table.insert(v73, p69)
			end
			return #v73 > 0 and {
				["kind"] = "union",
				["fields"] = nil,
				["fields"] = v73
			} or nil
		end
		if p69.kind ~= "table" then
			return p69
		end
		local v75 = {}
		if p69.fields then
			for v76, v77 in p69.fields do
				local v78 = rawget
				local v79 = v76.value
				local v80, v81 = pcall(v78, p68, v79)
				if not v80 then
					return nil
				end
				if not v_u_84(v81, v77, p70) then
					return nil
				end
				if not v76.value then
					continue
				end
				v75[v76.value] = p68
			end
		end
		if typeof(p68) == "table" and (p69.indexer or p69.value) then
			for v82, v83 in pairs(p68) do
				if v75[v82] then
					continue
				end
				if p69.indexer and not v_u_84(v82, p69.indexer, p70) then
					return nil
				end
				if not p69.value or v_u_84(v83, p69.value, p70) then
					continue
				end
				return nil
			end
		end
		return p69
	end
end
local function v_u_101(p85, p86, p87, p88) -- name: match
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_37, (copy) v_u_84, (copy) v_u_101
	if p86 then
		if p86.kind == "var" then
			local v89 = nil
			if p86.root.kind == "global" then
				v89 = p85.globals[p86.root.token.text]
			elseif p86.root.kind == "name" and p86.root.name then
				v89 = p85.vars[p86.root.name.text]
			elseif p86.root.kind == "paren" and p86.root.node.value then
				v89 = v_u_37(p86.root.node.value)
			end
			if not v89 then
				return nil
			end
			for _, v90 in p86.suffixes do
				if v90.kind == "expression_index" then
					local v91 = v_u_37(v90.node.value)
					local v92 = rawget
					local v93
					v93, v89 = pcall(v92, v89, v91)
					if v93 then
						continue
					end
					return nil
				end
				if v90.kind ~= "name_index" or not v90.name then
					continue
				end
				local v94 = v90.name.text
				local v95 = rawget
				local v96
				v96, v89 = pcall(v95, v89, v94)
				if v96 then
					continue
				end
				return nil
			end
			return v_u_84(v89, p87, p88)
		elseif p87.kind == "command" then
			if p86.kind == "command" then
				return p87
			else
				return nil
			end
		elseif p87.kind == "function" then
			if p86.kind == "lambda" then
				return p87
			else
				return nil
			end
		elseif p87.kind == "intersection" then
			for _, v97 in p87.fields do
				if v_u_101(p85, p86, v97, p88) then
					continue
				end
				return nil
			end
			return p87
		elseif p87.kind == "union" then
			local v98 = {}
			for _, v99 in p87.fields do
				if not v_u_101(p85, p86, v99, p88) then
					continue
				end
				table.insert(v98, v99)
			end
			return #v98 > 0 and {
				["kind"] = "union",
				["fields"] = nil,
				["fields"] = v98
			} or nil
		else
			if p87.kind == "strange" then
				local v100 = p87.match
				if typeof(v100) == "table" then
					if v_u_101(p85, p86, p87.match, p88) then
						return p87
					else
						return nil
					end
				end
			end
			if p87.kind == "strange" or (p87.kind == "literal" or p87.kind == "table") then
				return v_u_84(v_u_37(p86), p87, p88)
			else
				return nil
			end
		end
	else
		return nil
	end
end

local function v_u_213(p196, p197, p198) -- name: choose_command
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_195, (copy) v_u_101, (copy) v_u_191
	local v199 = {}
	local v200 = {}
	for _, v201 in v_u_195({}, p198) do
		if v201.kind ~= "command" then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(v199, v201)
		table.insert(v200, v201)
	end
	for v202 = #v199, 1, -1 do
		local v203 = v199[v202]
		local v204 = v203.arguments[#v203.arguments]
		local v205
		if v204 then
			v205 = v204.varargs
		else
			v205 = false
		end

			local v206 = false
			for v207, v208 in p197.arguments do
				local v209 = v203.arguments[v207]
				if #v203.arguments < v207 then
					if v205 then
						v209 = v204
					end
				end
				if v209 and (not v209.type or v_u_101(p196, v208, v209.type, true)) then
					continue
				end
				v206 = true
			end
			if not v206 then
				break
			end

			v199[#v199] = nil
		else
			v199[v202] = v199[#v199]
			v199[#v199] = nil
		end
	end

		local v210 = p196.issues
		local v211 = {
			["why"] = "no command matches the given type",
			["span"] = nil,
			["span"] = p197.span
		}

	end
	for _, v212 in v200 do
		v_u_191(p196, p197, v212)
	end
end
function v_u_38.visit_command(p214, p215) -- name: visit_command
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_176, (copy) v_u_191, (copy) v_u_213
	local v216 = p215.span
	if (p214.cursor < v216.x and "before" or (p214.cursor > v216.y and "after" or "within")) == "within" then
		local v217 = p215.var.span
		if (p214.cursor < v217.x and "before" or (p214.cursor > v217.y and "after" or "within")) == "after" then
			local v218 = p215.var.root
			if #p215.var.suffixes > 0 then
				return
			else
				local v219
				if v218.kind == "global" then
					local v220 = v218.token.text
					v219 = p214.vm.global_metadata[v220]
				else
					v219 = nil
				end
				if v219 == nil then
					return
				elseif v219.kind == "function" then
					v_u_176(p214, p215, v219)
					return
				elseif v219.kind == "command" then
					v_u_191(p214, p215, v219)
					return
				elseif v219.kind == "intersection" then
					v_u_213(p214, p215, v219)
				else
					local v221 = p214.issues
					local v222 = {
						["why"] = ("(this is a implementation issue) expected command type, got %*"):format(v219.kind),
						["span"] = p215.span
					}
					table.insert(v221, v222)
				end
			end
		else
			return
		end
	else
		return
	end
end

				["text"] = "for",
				["display"] = "for"
			})

			table.insert(v227, {
				["kind"] = nil,
				["metadata"] = nil,
				["text"] = "while",
				["display"] = "while"
			})
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
return {
	["analyze"] = function(p228, p229, p230) -- name: analyze
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_38, (copy) v_u_24
		local v231 = v_u_1.parse
		local v232 = buffer.fromstring(p229)
		local _, v233 = pcall(v231, v232)
		if not v233.result then
			return {
				["suggestions"] = nil,
				["replace"] = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),

			}

		local v234 = {
			["vars"] = table.clone(p228.state.scope.vars),
			["globals"] = table.clone(p228.state.globals),

		}
		v_u_1.visit.visit_ast(v_u_38, v234, v233.result)
		if v234.result and v234.result.suggestions then

	["is_compatible"] = function(p1, p2) -- name: is_compatible
		if p1.major == 0 and p2.minor == 0 then
			if p1.patch == p1.patch then
				return "ok", nil
			else
				return "likely_incompatible", ("requires %*, likely incompatible with %*"):format(("%*.%*.%*"):format(p1.major, p1.minor, p1.patch), (("%*.%*.%*"):format(p2.major, p2.minor, p2.patch)))
			end
		elseif p1.major == 0 then
			if p1.minor > p2.minor then
				return "likely_incompatible", ("requires %*, likely incompatible with %*"):format(("%*.%*.%*"):format(p1.major, p1.minor, p1.patch), (("%*.%*.%*"):format(p2.major, p2.minor, p2.patch)))
			end
			if p1.minor == p2.minor then
				if p1.patch <= p2.patch then
					return "ok", nil
				end
				if p1.patch > p2.patch then
					return "compatible", ("requires %*, while likely compatible with %*, API might not function as expected"):format(("%*.%*.%*"):format(p1.major, p1.minor, p1.patch), (("%*.%*.%*"):format(p2.major, p2.minor, p2.patch)))
				end

				return "likely_incompatible", ("requires %*, but api is at %*, this may indicate breaking changes"):format(("%*.%*.%*"):format(p1.major, p1.minor, p1.patch), (("%*.%*.%*"):format(p2.major, p2.minor, p2.patch)))
			end
			return "bad", ("unreachable condition reached %* %*"):format(("%*.%*.%*"):format(p1.major, p1.minor, p1.patch), (("%*.%*.%*"):format(p2.major, p2.minor, p2.patch)))
		elseif p1.major == p2.major then
			if p1.minor > p2.minor then
				return "likely_incompatible", ("requires %* which may depend on additional api\'s, which might not be available within %*"):format(("%*.%*.%*"):format(p1.major, p1.minor, p1.patch), (("%*.%*.%*"):format(p2.major, p2.minor, p2.patch)))

local function v_u_200(p166, p167, p168, p169, p170) -- name: serverAt
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5
	local v171 = p166.snaps
	local v172 = #v171
	if p170 then
		while v172 > 1 and p170 < v171[v172].t do
			v172 = v172 - 1
		end
	end
	local v173 = v171[v172]

		local v174 = p167 - v173.t

			local v176 = v173.v
			if v176.Magnitude < 0.01 or not p168 then
				return v173.p, v176, false
			else

				if (p168 - v177):Dot(v176) <= 0 then
					return p168, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), false

				end
			end
		else
			local v178 = v_u_5.Make(v173.p, v173.dir, v173.s, v173.k)
			v178.flown = v173.x

				v180 = math.clamp(v182, v183, v186)
				v181 = p169.slowFactor
			else
				v180 = 0
				v181 = 1
			end
			local v187 = v173.speed
			if v175 <= 1e-6 then
				return v178.pos, v_u_5.Rate(v178, v187), true
			end
			if (v178.pos - p168).Magnitude <= v180 then
				v187 = v173.speed * v181
			else

			end

			v_u_5.Step(v178, p168, v189, p169)

				continue
			end

		end

			if v191.t > p167 then
				continue
			end
			local v192 = v171[v190 + 1]

			local v194

				return v191.p * (v197 * 2 - v196 * 3 + 1) + v191.v * (v193 * (v197 - v196 * 2 + v194)) + v192.p * (v197 * -2 + v196 * 3) + v192.v * (v193 * (v197 - v196)), v191.v:Lerp(v192.v, v194), true

local function v_u_459(p443, p444) -- name: between
	local v445 = p443.snaps
	local v446 = #v445
	if v446 == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local v447 = v445[v446]
	if v447.t > p444 then
		for v448 = v446 - 1, 1, -1 do
			local v449 = v445[v448]
			if v449.t > p444 then
				continue
			end
			local v450 = v445[v448 + 1]
			local v451 = v450.t - v449.t
			if v451 <= 1e-6 then
				return v450.p
			end
			local v452 = (p444 - v449.t) / v451
			local v453 = math.clamp(v452, 0, 1)
			if v449.flight ~= v450.flight then
				return v449.p:Lerp(v450.p, v453)
			end
			local v454 = v453 * v453
			local v455 = v453 * v453 * v453
			return v449.p * (v455 * 2 - v454 * 3 + 1) + v449.v * ((v455 - v454 * 2 + v453) * v451) + v450.p * (v455 * -2 + v454 * 3) + v450.v * ((v455 - v454) * v451)
		end
		return v445[1].p
	end
	local v456 = v447.p
	local v457 = v447.v
	local v458 = p444 - v447.t
	return v456 + v457 * math.min(v458, 0.1)
end

			end

		end
	end
end

	if v_u_273 == "Volume" then
		local v284 = v_u_18
		local v285 = (Vector2.new(p283.X, p283.Y) - v284.AbsolutePosition) / v284.AbsoluteSize
		local v286 = v285.X
		local v287 = math.clamp(v286, 0, 1)
		local v288 = v285.Y
		math.clamp(v288, 0, 1)
		v_u_49(v287)
		return
	elseif v_u_273 == "Fov" then
		local v289 = v_u_71
		local v290 = (Vector2.new(p283.X, p283.Y) - v289.AbsolutePosition) / v289.AbsoluteSize
		local v291 = v290.X
		local v292 = math.clamp(v291, 0, 1)
		local v293 = v290.Y
		math.clamp(v293, 0, 1)
		local v294 = math.clamp(v292, 0, 1) * 50 + 70 + 0.5
		local v295 = math.floor(v294)
		if v_u_5:GetAttribute("FieldOfView") ~= v295 then
			v_u_5:SetAttribute("SettingsChanged", true)
			v_u_5:SetAttribute("FieldOfView", v295)
		end
	elseif v_u_273 == "Sfx" then
		local v296 = v_u_52
		local v297 = (Vector2.new(p283.X, p283.Y) - v296.AbsolutePosition) / v296.AbsoluteSize
		local v298 = v297.X
		local v299 = math.clamp(v298, 0, 1)
		local v300 = v297.Y
		math.clamp(v300, 0, 1)
		local v301 = math.clamp(v299, 0, 1) * 100 + 0.5
		local v302 = math.floor(v301) / 100
		if v_u_5:GetAttribute("SfxVolume") ~= v302 then
			v_u_5:SetAttribute("SettingsChanged", true)
			v_u_5:SetAttribute("SfxVolume", v302)
		end
	else
		local v303 = v_u_273
		if type(v303) == "string" and v_u_282.drags[v_u_273] then
			v_u_282.drags[v_u_273](p283)
		else
			local v304 = v_u_273
			if type(v304) == "table" then
				local v305 = v_u_273.picker
				if v_u_273.part == "SV" then
					local v306 = v305.spec.sv
					local v307 = (Vector2.new(p283.X, p283.Y) - v306.AbsolutePosition) / v306.AbsoluteSize
					local v308 = v307.X
					local v309 = math.clamp(v308, 0, 1)
					local v310 = v307.Y
					local v311 = 1 - math.clamp(v310, 0, 1)
					v305.s = v309
					v305.v = v311
				else
					local v312 = v305.spec.hue
					local v313 = (Vector2.new(p283.X, p283.Y) - v312.AbsolutePosition) / v312.AbsoluteSize
					local v314 = v313.X
					math.clamp(v314, 0, 1)
					local v315 = v313.Y
					local v316 = math.clamp(v315, 0, 1)
					v305.h = math.min(v316, 0.999)
				end
				v305.applyHSV()
			end
		end
	end
end

local function v341(p_u_319) -- name: newPicker
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_274, (ref) v_u_273, (copy) v_u_317, (copy) v_u_281, (copy) v_u_277, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_318
	local v_u_320 = {
		["h"] = 0,
		["s"] = 0.84,
		["v"] = 1,
		["spec"] = nil,
		["spec"] = p_u_319
	}
	local v_u_321 = p_u_319.sv:WaitForChild("Cursor")
	local v_u_322 = p_u_319.hue:WaitForChild("Cursor")
	function v_u_320.color() -- name: color
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_5, (copy) p_u_319
		local v323 = v_u_5:GetAttribute(p_u_319.attribute)
		if typeof(v323) == "Color3" then
			return v323
		else
			return p_u_319.default
		end
	end
	function v_u_320.redraw() -- name: redraw
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_320, (copy) p_u_319, (copy) v_u_321, (copy) v_u_322
		local v324 = v_u_320.color()
		p_u_319.preview(v324)
		p_u_319.sv.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(v_u_320.h, 1, 1)
		v_u_321.Position = UDim2.fromScale(v_u_320.s, 1 - v_u_320.v)
		v_u_321.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(v_u_320.h, v_u_320.s, v_u_320.v)
		v_u_322.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, v_u_320.h)
		if not p_u_319.hex:IsFocused() then
			p_u_319.hex.Text = "#" .. string.upper(v324:ToHex())
		end
		for _, v325 in not p_u_319.presets and {} or p_u_319.presets:GetChildren() do
			if not v325:IsA("GuiButton") then
				continue
			end
			local v326 = v325:FindFirstChild("Rim")
			local v327 = v325.BackgroundColor3:ToHex() == v324:ToHex()
			if not v326 then
				continue
			end
			v326.Transparency = v327 and 0 or 0.6
			v326.Thickness = v327 and 2.5 or 1.5
		end
	end
	function v_u_320.load() -- name: load
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_320
		local v328, v329, v330 = v_u_320.color():ToHSV()
		if v329 > 0.001 and v330 > 0.001 then
			v_u_320.h = v328
		end
		if v330 > 0.001 then
			v_u_320.s = v329
		end
		v_u_320.v = v330
	end
	function v_u_320.set(p331) -- name: set
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_274, (ref) v_u_5, (copy) p_u_319
		if v_u_274.Owns(v_u_5, "Colors") then
			v_u_5:SetAttribute("SettingsChanged", true)
			v_u_5:SetAttribute(p_u_319.attribute, p331)
		end
	end
	function v_u_320.applyHSV() -- name: applyHSV
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_320
		v_u_320.set(Color3.fromHSV(v_u_320.h, v_u_320.s, v_u_320.v))
		v_u_320.redraw()
	end
	for _, v_u_332 in {
		{ p_u_319.sv:WaitForChild("Hit"), "SV" },
		{ p_u_319.hue:WaitForChild("Hit"), "Hue" }
	} do
		v_u_332[1].InputBegan:Connect(function(p333)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_273, (copy) v_u_320, (copy) v_u_332, (ref) v_u_317
			if p333.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and true or p333.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				v_u_273 = {
					["picker"] = v_u_320,
					["part"] = v_u_332[2]

			end
		end)
	end
	for _, v_u_334 in not p_u_319.presets and {} or p_u_319.presets:GetChildren() do
		if not v_u_334:IsA("GuiButton") then
			continue
		end
		v_u_281(v_u_334, 1.12)
		v_u_334.Activated:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_277, (copy) v_u_334, (copy) v_u_320

			v_u_320.redraw()
		end)
	end
	v_u_281(p_u_319.reset, 1.04)
	p_u_319.reset.Activated:Connect(function()

		v_u_277(p_u_319.reset)
		v_u_320.set(nil)
		v_u_320.load()
		v_u_320.redraw()
	end)
	p_u_319.hex.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_319, (copy) v_u_320
		local v335 = p_u_319.hex.Text:gsub("[^%x]", "")
		if #v335 == 3 then
			v335 = v335:gsub("%x", "%0%0")
		end
		if #v335 == 6 then
			local v336 = Color3.fromHex
			local v337, v338 = pcall(v336, v335)
			if v337 then
				v_u_320.set(v338)
				v_u_320.load()
			end
		end
		v_u_320.redraw()
	end)
	v_u_5:GetAttributeChangedSignal(p_u_319.attribute):Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_273, (copy) v_u_320, (ref) v_u_13
		local v339 = v_u_273
		if type(v339) ~= "table" or v_u_273.picker ~= v_u_320 then
			if not v_u_13.Visible then
				v_u_320.load()
			end
			v_u_320.redraw()
		end
	end)
	local v340 = v_u_318
	table.insert(v340, v_u_320)
	return v_u_320
end
